0.name: TEXT_CMNBHTREWARDLV020ST0003_00025_TALK_00
0.description: Time is of the essence. If you have something to ask, make it quick.
0.translation_description: Il tempo stringe. Se hai qualcosa da chiedermi, fai in fretta.

1.name: TEXT_CMNBHTREWARDLV020ST0003_00025_MENU_TITLE
1.description: What would you like to do?

5.name: TEXT_CMNBHTREWARDLV020ST0003_00025_RETURN_ME_MENU_TITLE
5.description: You will be removed from your party. Proceed?

11.name: TEXT_CMNBHTREWARDLV020ST0003_00025_RET_TALK_00
11.description: The operation was a success! Here's your reward, and don't let anyone tell you that you didn't earn it.
11.translation_description: Operazione riuscita! Ecco la tua ricompensa. E non lasciare che qualcuno ti dica che non te la sei meritata.

12.name: TEXT_CMNBHTREWARDLV020ST0003_00025_RET_SUCCESS_SYSTEM_TALK_00
12.description: You will leave the instance once all party members have collected their rewards.
12.translation_description: Uscirai dall'istanza quando tutti i membri del gruppo avranno ritirato le ricompense.

13.name: TEXT_CMNBHTREWARDLV020ST0003_00025_RET_FAIL_TALK_00
13.description: Well, well. It looks like you have a full bag.
13.translation_description: Ehi, ehi. La tua borsa sembra piena.

14.name: TEXT_CMNBHTREWARDLV020ST0003_00025_RET_FAIL_SYSTEM_TALK_00
14.description: Make room in your inventory and speak with the battlewarden once again to receive your reward.
14.translation_description: Libera spazio nell'inventario e parla di nuovo con il custode di battaglia per ricevere la ricompensa.

15.name: TEXT_CMNBHTREWARDLV020ST0003_00025_AFTER_RWD_TALK_00
15.description: Can't you see I'm busy attending to your allies? I don't have time to chat.
15.translation_description: Non vedi che sono occupato ad aiutare i tuoi alleati? Non ho tempo di chiacchierare.

19.name: TEXT_CMNBHTREWARDLV020ST0003_00025_AFTER_RWD_RETURN_MENU_TITLE
19.description: You will be removed from the party. Proceed?

22.name: TEXT_CMNBHTREWARDLV020ST0003_00025_FIRST_BONUS_TALK_00
22.description: The operation was a success! Here's your payment, and as promised, I've thrown in a little extra, so that you may consider returning to aid us once again.
22.translation_description: Operazione riuscita! Ecco il tuo compenso. Come promesso, ho aggiunto un piccolo extra: magari tornerai ad aiutarci ancora una volta.

23.name: TEXT_CMNBHTREWARDLV020ST0003_00025_FIRST_BONUS_SYSTEM_TALK_00
23.description: A bonus has been added to your reward.
23.translation_description: È stato aggiunto un bonus alla tua ricompensa.
